services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Tiki Boat is a custom charter Party Boat with plenty of room for whatever you need on the upper deck! All of Tiki Boats custom charters can come equipped with a Live DJ and fine catering to suit your needs! Newport Beach Harbors first charter boat - The M.V. Tiki bears a casual atmosphere and a striking resemblance to a tropical rain forest. Tiki Boat is a double deck party boat from bow to stern, and can accommodate 75 - 100 guests comfortably for a private function. On the lower deck, there are facilities for a DJ or small band, a dance area, tables and chairs, which can be arranged for dining.
